tools.name: search_stocks
tools.description: Find US-listed companies Ryufin covers by ticker or company name. Returns ticker, name, sector, market value and the Ryufin page.

tools.name: get_stock_answers
tools.description: Ryufin's five answers for one stock: is the business good, is it safe, is the price fair, is it growing, what is the market doing with it. Each answer has a one-word verdict, a plain sentence, the checks it was read from (with values and dates) and, when it moved recently, what it was before.

tools.name: get_stock_overview
tools.description: Price, market value, P/E, returns, sector, RyuScore (0 to 100 from seven weighted criteria) and what the company says it does, verbatim from its latest annual report.

tools.name: get_financial_history
tools.description: A reported financial series for one stock from its SEC filings, trailing twelve months or single quarters, newest last. Metrics: pe, revenue, net_income, eps, gross_margin, op_margin, net_margin, roe, roa, roic, fcf.

tools.name: get_company_news
tools.description: The company's own recent current reports (8-K), newest first: the date, what kind of event, the company's own sentence and a link to the filing on sec.gov.

tools.name: get_answer_changes
tools.description: Stocks whose answer to one of the five questions changed in the latest nightly run (for example Safety from Good to Watch), largest companies first.
